name: table_bench2
description: table_bench2 evaluates model performance on question answering and reasoning over structured tabular data. It contains queries that require filtering, aggregation, lookup, and multi-step reasoning over table rows and columns. The benchmark is intended to measure models' ability to interpret table structure and perform accurate, table-grounded answers.
reputation: A smaller, task-focused table QA benchmark with modest visibility compared to larger table QA suites; primarily used in targeted research.
